lines.text: Many learners say: Is very cold today.
Better: It is very cold today.

native.tip: 한국어는 주어를 자주 생략하지만 영어는 꼭 필요해요. “It is very cold today”!
native.caption: “Is very cold today.”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 한국어처럼 주어를 생략하면 안 되고, 날씨 얘기에도 “It”이 꼭 필요해요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “It is very cold today.” Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.

en.tip: English always needs a subject, even for weather. Say “It is very cold today.”
en.caption: Do you say “Is very cold today” in English? 😅 English needs a subject, even for weather. “It is very cold today” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
